title: Burj Khalifa: Height, Floors, Cost | Skyscraper Day
content:
The Burj Khalifa is 828 m (2,717 ft) tall and has 163 floors. The figure is architectural height, measured from the entrance level to the top of the spire. Add the antenna and the total passes 829 m.

Two smaller numbers matter more to anyone inside. The highest occupied floor sits at 585 m, and the top 240 m hold the spire and mechanical plant rather than rooms. For how the measurement is decided, and who decides it, seethe height record page.

# The Burj Khalifa

A single tower in Downtown Dubai that is half again as tall as anything built before it, paid for by a property developer, named after the ruler of a neighboring emirate, and open to visitors on three floors near the top.

It opened the 148th floor SKY level at 555 m (1,821 ft), giving it the highest observation deck in the world on 15 October 2014. However, in June 2016 the Shanghai Tower opened with an observation deck at a height of 561 metres, thus taking the title of the world's highest observation deck. title: Burj Khalifa | The Skyscraper Museum
content:
In April 2007, The Skyscraper Museum presented an exhibition on the skyscraper that was to become, and still is in 2020, the world's tallest building, Burj Khalifa. At the time called "Burj Dubai," the tower was under construction, on its way to 163 stories and ultimate height of 828 meters/ 2,717 ft. title: Shanghai Tower – Supertall!
content: The tallest skyscraper in Asia in 2018 and the second tallest in the world, Shanghai Tower’s spiraling form rises 128 stories – 2073 ft. / 632 m. in Lujiazui, the new business district of Pudong on the east side of the Huangpu River in Shanghai. With a population of more than 24 million in its urban area, Shanghai is the largest city in China by population. Its skyline features other three iconic towers: the Oriental Pearl Tower, the Jin Mao Building, and the Shanghai World Financial Center.
